typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FilePathBuySellBreaks as string ('\\ cwcnhf501.wellsfargo.com\\DRSDev\\WFSOpsKRIReporting\\DropZone\\Broadridge\\StreetsideActivity\\BuyAndSellBreaks\\Copy of EQUITY BUY and SELL BREAKS 01-28-25.csv'),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		MO as string,
		INV as string,
		ACCOUNT as string,
		{T D} as string,
		{S D} as string,
		{B  S} as string,
		QTY as string,
		SYM as string,
		PX as string,
		AMOUNT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(LoadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		FileName = toString((substring(toString($FilePathBuySellBreaks), toInteger(111), toInteger(43)))),
		FileDate = toString((substring(toString($FilePathBuySellBreaks), toInteger(146), toInteger(8))))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		INV as string,
		TD as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SD as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		BS as string,
		MO as string,
		ACCOUNT as string,
		AMOUNT as integer,
		Symbol as string,
		QTY as string,
		FileName as string,
		PX as integer,
		Load_Date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		INV,
		TD = {T D},
		SD = {S D},
		BS = {B  S},
		MO,
		ACCOUNT,
		AMOUNT,
		Symbol = SYM,
		QTY,
		FileName,
		PX,
		Load_Date = LoadDate),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
